identification: Round two-tier bentwood occasional table, dark stained beech, black moulded rim, brown inset leathercloth top, lower shelf with punched/embossed whiplash panel. Single photo, no label visible. Viennese bentwood style c.1900-1920; Thonet or Kohn attribution unproven and many similar tables were made by Czech and Polish firms (Fischel, Mundus, Ton, Radomsko).

viewing_check: Look underneath and on the legs and shelf rim for a Thonet or J&J Kohn paper label, burnt or stamped mark, or Czech/Poland stamp; check the legs are true bentwood (steam-bent, no joins) and the shelf panel is original; photograph the underside. Without a label expect a plain $40-120 table.
